document.title: Procedure for the RELAP5 Transient Analyses

items.statement: The nodalization developer prepares and maintains the base input deck and its supporting notebook worksheets.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 1. preparation of base input deck
2. preparation of worksheets for RELAP5 notebook
3. maintenance (minor revisions) of the base input deck

evidence_quotes.quote_original: supervision of the preparation and the maintenance (minor revisions) of the base

items.statement: The RELAP software engineer is responsible for program installation, maintenance, testing, script preparation, and software modification.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: 1. installation and maintenance of RELAP5 and RELAP5 plot programs
2. testing of RELAP5 program and RELAP5 plot programs

items.statement: The base input model must represent the plant, retain traceable geometry and input data, and reproduce reference steady-state conditions within predefined limits.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Base input deck shall be complete and prepared to represent model of respective NPP in compliance with Ref. [2].

1. geometrical fidelity with the plant is achieved and well documented (verified by the base input deck notebook that ensures all the input data are traceable and close physical representation of the actual plant).

2. referenced steady-state condition is satisfactory reproduced (that is, difference between calculation results and reference is within predefined limits as verified by Steady-State Technical Report).

items.statement: A supervisor must verify and approve base-model applicability to the specified initial conditions, systems, and protection setpoints before transient analysis proceeds.

sources.source_locator: 4.2.1.4 Base input deck applicability, page 18, lines 525-534

evidence_quotes.quote_original: d. Nodalization supervisor shall verify base input deck applicability according to format presented in Appendix 6.6.
e. RELAP5 analyst shall proceed with transient analysis only if base input deck is approved as applicable.

items.statement: Transient analysis inputs include defined initial and boundary conditions and identified physical phenomena relevant to the safety analysis.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: Initial and boundary conditions shall be defined according to the transient specifications:
1. Main phenomena shall be identified:

2. Relevant thermohydraulic aspects shall be defined for main phenomena (e.g. if core dryout is identified as main phenomena than relevant thermohydraulic aspects may be rod surface temperature and core level).

items.statement: The procedure establishes a systematic instruction set for preparing RELAP5 models, documentation, calculations, and results.

evidence_quotes.quote_original: The purpose of the procedure is to provide systematic approach to the accident/transient analyses using RELAP5 computer code. It is also intended to describe necessary requirements for the preparation of the input models, documentation and output results.
This procedure gives the instructions for specific activities for performing accident / transient analysis using RELAP5 computer code.
